comment: What a new version brings, as the General page lists it (D-397). The notes of a release hold the English part, a line <!-- ru -->, and the Russian part. A point starts with its title in bold; the list takes the titles, without the full stop, in order, at most 8. Notes without a Russian part give the English titles in Russian too. A JSON answer of GitHub carries the notes in its body.

titles.name: both languages
titles.notes:
### Added

- **Settings in the window.** Ctrl+, opens them.
- **Notices name the agent.** Text.

<!-- ru -->

### Добавлено

- **Настройки в окне.** Ctrl+, открывает их.
- **Уведомления говорят об агенте.** Текст.

titles.name: english only
titles.notes:
### Fixed

- **The terminal no longer jerks.** When the header opens.
- A line without a bold title is not a point.
